name: fabric
description: Multi-provider agent fabric — any agent (Claude / Codex / …) invoking, orchestrating, and handing off to models of any provider. One `call` primitive (task/review/agent/image modes) + fan_out + a minimal observe proxy that captures a child's API traffic.

defaultPrompt: Use the Fabric plugin to invoke, orchestrate, and hand off to models of any provider (claude / codex / any ai-lab catalogue provider).
Tools: call (one-shot; mode task/review/agent/image-*; codex supports write:true + cwd), fan_out (parallel calls), list_providers, resolve_model, codex_status.
Pass observe:true to call to capture the child API traffic into runDir/http.jsonl.
